core.notes:
Update notices now offer Reload first, then Install: Tampermonkey has usually installed the new version already, and the open tab only needs a reload to run it (Install used to open a page that said Reinstall). The Updates page does the same
A tab still running an older AWOO+ or module after another tab loaded a newer one now says "Reload to run <version>", with a Reload button
Closing a notice removes it at once instead of fading out
New Notifications setting: click anywhere on a notice to close it (on by default; its buttons still work)
Notifications page: a history of your last notices, newest first (keep 10, 20, 30, 50 or 100), with Clear
Profile Sync now records your running potions (new Potions section)
Cost Tables: Village Strengths now says "Village Strength" instead of "Unrecorded currency"; your Sanctum skill-tree points and lowest partner skill level now sync; level/target/step boxes have no arrows and larger numbers
Cost Tables: number boxes have no arrows and larger numbers, the mouse wheel steps a box without scrolling the page, and checkboxes match AWOO+'s
New General › Time zone setting: show every AWOO+ time in server time (UTC, the old behaviour), your computer's own time zone, or a zone you pick from a search list. This only changes how times are shown — the daily reset and weekly party runs still happen on server time
Fixed: a trusted or dev-only module's name in the drop-down menu lost its colour while the module was loaded (open modules showed yellow instead); it now shows a small coloured mark after the name that always stays visible
Number boxes in AWOO+ windows no longer show the up/down arrows, and scrolling over one now steps its value instead of scrolling the page (the page still scrolls normally everywhere else)
Cost Tables: a pet slot past level 180 keeps adding 6% a level (patch 1.2.3.13); the "boost falls to +450%" marker is gone
